tables.name: archive_counters
tables.description: Maintains per-organisation monthly counters (yyyymm and seq) for generating sequential archive_code values; used by the set_patient_archive_code function triggered before inserting patients.

tables.name: battery_prescription_deliveries
tables.description: Records battery prescription deliveries, quantities, and SGK reimbursement expectations for patients.

tables.name: device_catalog_models
tables.description: Defines catalog items (brand, model, item_type) scoped by organisation; used during device catalog import to create or find models.

tables.name: device_catalog_prices
tables.description: Stores price history for catalog models, with effective dates and purchase/list prices; updated during catalog import.

tables.name: device_repairs
tables.description: Tracks repairs of inventory devices, including statuses, dates, and linkage to patients or meetings.

tables.name: import_jobs
tables.description: Manages CSV import jobs (inventory, patients, trials, legacy devices) and their status, row counts, and error information.

tables.name: inventory_import_rows
tables.description: Staging table for inventory CSV imports; holds parsed rows and validation status before committing to inventory_items.

tables.name: inventory_items
tables.description: Primary inventory table storing devices and accessories, their status (in_stock, sold, repair), prices, and sale metadata.

tables.name: meeting_accessories
tables.description: Associates accessories sold during a meeting with a patient and meeting, recording cost and sale price.

tables.name: meeting_payments
tables.description: Records payments made during a meeting for a patient, including amount and payment method.

tables.name: meeting_satisfaction_question_lists
tables.description: Templates of satisfaction survey question lists; each list holds multiple questions and can be activated/deactivated.

tables.name: meeting_satisfaction_questions
tables.description: Individual satisfaction survey questions linked to a question list; includes order and active status.

tables.name: meeting_satisfaction_answers
tables.description: Stores answers provided by patients to satisfaction surveys for meetings, linking to question and list IDs.

tables.name: meetings
tables.description: Represents appointments or meetings with patients or trial subjects, including timing, notes, and references.

tables.name: org_settings
tables.description: Per-organisation settings such as company name, contact details and branding; editable via settings UI.

tables.name: patients
tables.description: Core patient records storing personal, contact, SGK and financial data; links to references and archives.

tables.name: patients_import_rows
tables.description: Staging table for patient CSV imports; holds raw rows, normalized payload and status before committing to patients.

tables.name: patients_legacy_devices_import_rows
tables.description: Staging table for importing legacy patient-device data; processed to create inventory_items and link to patients.

tables.name: profiles
tables.description: User profiles holding org_id, role and admin flag; used to resolve organisation context across API calls.

tables.name: reference_gifts
tables.description: Records gifts or commissions given to reference contacts for successful referrals.

tables.name: references
tables.description: Stores referral contacts and their metadata (contact info, commission scheme, activity); linked to patients.

tables.name: trial_devices
tables.description: Covers devices assigned to trials, including ear side and quoted price, linked to trials.

tables.name: trials
tables.description: Represents trial period for prospective patients; holds contact info, meeting schedule and reference link.

tables.name: patient_installment_plans
tables.description: Stores payment plans for patients including total amount, upfront payment, installment count and status.

tables.name: patient_sale_breakdown
tables.description: Breaks down patient sales into payment methods and amounts; used when recording payments and reports.

views.name: current_device_model_prices_public
views.description: View returning the most recent device model prices per organisation, used when creating inventory and fetching catalog.

views.name: current_device_catalog_prices_public
views.description: View returning current catalog prices for devices per organisation.

views.name: trial_devices_with_catalog_public
views.description: View joining trial devices with catalog models and prices for easier selection and reporting.

views.name: patient_list_with_device
views.description: View listing patients with aggregated device information, used for patient list page.

views.name: patient_list_with_device_all
views.description: View similar to patient_list_with_device but includes soft-deleted patients; used in admin contexts.
